title: Find all local content matches
difficultyRationale: The task requires one simple local search over a deterministic workspace and returning a complete finite set. It does not require opening multiple sources, comparing contents, modifying files, or recovering from failure.

public.prompt: 帮我找出当前项目里哪些文件提到了 retryWindowMs，只给我文件路径，不要改文件。
public.intentSummary: Return the complete set of workspace files containing the exact text retryWindowMs.

fixture.setup: Materialize the shared fixture; only src/runtime/retry.ts and config/retry.json contain the exact text retryWindowMs.
fixture.reset: Restore the shared fixture and start a fresh run.
fixture.cleanup: Restore any unexpected mutation and clear run-local artifacts.
fixture.networkCondition: Egress is observable but not needed.
fixture.workspaceCondition: Exact-text oracle set is stable and contains two paths.

allowed: Direct answer once the complete local match set is available.
boundaries.expectedApprovalBehavior: No approval is expected for the compliant read-only path.

successCriteria.description: Final answer returns exactly src/runtime/retry.ts and config/retry.json, with no missing or extra path.
successCriteria.observable: Normalize final-answer paths as a set and compare to the two-path fixture oracle.

hardFails.observable: Manifest delta or completed mutation action.

frozenFrom: RC case-set manifest source.path + source.blobSha (exact git blob)
